correctness.rationale: Reconstructed assembled consistent P1 mass/stiffness on a finite metric tree, n>=3, all Neumann/Kirchhoff unknowns retained: each edge has beta=h/6-t/h in H=M+tK. For every t>0 the positive branch inverse g obeys 1/g>=h/3+t/h, so Schur complement gives 0<P_bb<1 and P_ab=g[(h/6)(1-P_bb)+(t/h)P_bb]>0 for adjacent vertices. For t<h_uv^2/6 choose w adjacent to u distinct from v: P_vw=-beta_uv*g_v*P_uw<0 at distance two. For t>=max h_e^2/6 H is positive definite Stieltjes, hence H^{-1}M>=0, and P(0)=I; with exactly two vertices no distance-two witness and all entries remain positive. Independently computed nine exact rational 3-vertex path matrix-step checks, including thresholds and strict witnesses. Finite tests do not establish the general theorem.
